evidence.title: I spent $266 and four AI models to own my tablet. GLM-5.3 finished it in a day

summary: A user spent $266 and tested four AI models to complete a task on their tablet, with GLM-5.3 finishing it in just one day. The result highlights the model's efficiency and potential advantages over competitors.
title: AI Model GLM-5.3 Solves Complex Task in a Day, Outperforming Other Models
